intent: The ground loop's device page displays its state from the liveness record — last run, state, and pid — as a declared pane.
why: A read-projection of the record, not a second source. The pane computes nothing about liveness; it renders what the loop wrote. Every surface is a view (the bus/one-web-server rule).
falsifier: The pane displays a liveness the record does not say — i.e. it derives or caches rather than renders. And: the pane must be honest when the record is STALE or ABSENT, showing 'not running' or 'unknown' rather than blank or a last-known-good.

BUILDME.need: ground-loop-writes-its-own-liveness — the pane renders that record
the ground loop gets a device PAGE the way every device does — a declared pane via BaseShim, never its own route or port (memory: one-web-server-surfaces-in-the-shim)

watchme: none, because a pure read-projection's falsifier is settled by a proof, not by time.
